```{r}
#Load preformatted datasets/lists
HU<- readRDS(paste0(source_path, "human_gene_list_11.3.25_list.rds"))
CG<- readRDS(paste0(source_path, "chemical_gene_list_analytic_11.3.25.rds"))
```

```{r}
#Generate pseudo-disease lists of 50, 100, 200, 400, 1000 to represent tested disease gene lists 
#try unlist to turn hum into a vector and see if thatll work for random sample
t.hum<- unlist(HU$Hum)




random_subsets <- replicate(n = 1, 
                            expr = sample(t.hum, size = 50), 
                            simplify = FALSE)

random_subsets2 <- replicate(n = 1, 
                            expr = sample(t.hum, size = 100), 
                            simplify = FALSE)

random_subsets3 <- replicate(n = 1, 
                            expr = sample(t.hum, size = 150), 
                            simplify = FALSE)

random_subsets4 <- replicate(n = 1, 
                            expr = sample(t.hum, size = 200), 
                            simplify = FALSE)

random_subsets5 <- replicate(n = 1, 
                            expr = sample(t.hum, size = 400), 
                            simplify = FALSE)

random_subsets6 <- replicate(n = 1, 
                            expr = sample(t.hum, size = 1000), 
                            simplify = FALSE)




```

# set 1

```{r}
#get cell values for 2x2 tables
# N: total number of human genes in genome
# N0_: unique number of genes per chemical
# N_0: unique number of genes related to ER stress
# a: number of genes related to ER and Chem for each chemical
# b: For each chemical: number of genes associated with chemical only
# c: for each chemical: number of genes associated with chemical only
# d: For each chemical: number of genes not associated with either chemical or ER
#=====================================================================================

#---------------------------------------------------------
#N: count number of genes in human genome list
#save as value 
#N <- length(unique(HU$Hum))
N <- length(HU$Hum)

#---------------------------------------------------------
#N0_: count total number of unique gene_symbols per chem 
#save as matrix use for margin count
uniq.chem <- 
  do.call(rbind, 
          lapply(CG, function(x) length(unique(x$gene_symbol))))

N0_ <- uniq.chem





#---------------------------------------------------------
#N_0: count number of DIS genes & save as list 
N_0 <- length(random_subsets[[1]]) 



#---------------------------------------------------------
#a: count number of genes related to DIS and Chem for each chemical
a <- sapply(CG, function(x) sum(x$gene_symbol %in% random_subsets[[1]])); a<-as.matrix(a, ncol=1)



#---------------------------------------------------------
#Get cell/margin counts using values obtained above
b = N0_ - a;
c = N_0 - a;
d = N-a-b-c;
N1_ = N - N0_; 
N_1 = N - N_0;


#---------------------------------------------------------
#Hum_t: 2x2 tables for all chemicals stored as list of dfs
# 1: save empty list for the information to go into 
# 2: combine all cell values by chemical
#-------------
# What the code is doing: 
#   For each item in the length of the chemical gene list 
#   combine cell values by row (chemical name) and create 
#   individual matrix for each chemical w/ 3 columns &
#   3 rows. Name each row and column to have appropriate 
#   titles save that whole thing as a list of data frames. 
#---------------------------------------------------------

Hum_t <- list()
for (i in 1:length(CG)) {
  
  Hum_t[[i]] <- matrix(c(a[i], b[i], N0_[1], 
                         c[i], d[i], N1_[1], 
                         N_0,  N_1,  N), ncol=3, byrow=T)
  
  rownames(Hum_t[[i]]) <- c("Yes","No","Total")
  colnames(Hum_t[[i]]) <- c("Yes","No","Total")
  
  Hum_t[[i]] <- as.data.frame(Hum_t[[i]])
}

#save names to match chem list 
names(Hum_t) <- names(CG)

#===============================================================================
#4: Fishers exact test
#===============================================================================
# Fisher test
fisher <- lapply(Hum_t, function(x) fisher.test(x[1:2,1:2], simulate.p.value = TRUE))
f <- data.frame(matrix(unlist(fisher), nrow=1008, byrow=TRUE),stringsAsFactors=FALSE) 


#fix names names
row.names(f) <- names(Hum_t)
names(f)[1] <- "fisher_pvalue"
names(f)[2] <- "fisher_LCI"
names(f)[3] <- "fisher_UCI"
names(f)[4] <- "fisher_estimate"

#restrict 
f<- select(f, 1:4)

#FDR correction
#f$fisher_FDR <- p.adjust(f$fisher_pvalue, method="fdr")
#add categorical identifier for plotting
f$sample_size <- rep("50", 1008)
```

```{r}
plot(density(f$fisher_FDR))
```

  labs(title = "Fisher Exact Test p-values density plot", x = "p-value for association", y = "Density") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed" ) +
  theme_minimal()

```{r}
#=====================================================================================
## Cross Validation
#===================================================================================
library(RColorBrewer)

sample

cv_int  <- list(); cv_gene <- list(); cv_rac  <- list()
chisq_test <- array(); fisher_test <- array()
# No. of random samples
cut_offs <- c(100, 500, 1000, 2500, 5000, 10000)
# set color
cols  <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"), alpha=TRUE)(length(cut_offs))

lapply(cut_offs, function(N0_) {
  
  for (i in 1:100) {
    
    # random sample
    cv_int[[i]]  <- sample.int(N, 100)              
    cv_gene[[i]] <- HU$Hum[cv_int[[i]],]      
    # find intersections between chemical and pseudo Disease-Gene list 
    cv_rac[[i]]  <- cv_gene[[i]][which(cv_gene[i]$Hum %in% DIS$gene_symbol),] 
    
    a = nrow(cv_rac[[i]])
    b = N0_ - a;
    c = N_0 - a;
    d = N-a-b-c;
    N1_ = N - N0_; 
    N_1 = N - N_0;
    
    Table <- matrix(c(a,b,N0_,c,d,N1_,N_0,N_1,N), ncol=3, byrow=T)
    Table <- as.data.frame.matrix(Table)
    
    if (N0_ <= 1000) {
      chisq_res <- chisq.test(Table[1:2,1:2], simulate.p.value=T)
      chisq_test[i] <- chisq_res$p.value
    } else {
      chisq_res <- chisq.test(Table[1:2,1:2], correct=F)
      chisq_test[i] <- chisq_res$p.value       
    }
    
    
    fisher_res <- fisher.test(Table[1:2,1:2])
    fisher_test[i] <- fisher_res$p.value
    
  }
  
  hist(chisq_test, las=1, col="dodgerblue", breaks=20,
       xlim=c(0,1), ylim=c(0,600),
       xlab="Chi-squared p-values for association",
       main=as.character(paste0("Chisq, Sample size = ", N0_)))
  
  hist(fisher_test, las=1, col="darkorange", breaks=20,
       xlim=c(0,1), ylim=c(0,600),
       xlab="Fisher's test p-values for association",
       main=as.character(paste0("Fisher, Sample size = ", N0_)))
})



```
